newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SEBI asks for review on Daewoo Securities.
newsitem.headline: India's SEBI asks for review on Daewoo Securities.

text.p: The capital markets regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Monday it had asked the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to review the status of Daewoo Securities.

Daewoo Securities' operations were affected by the regulatory authorities' decision to scrutinise the firm because of its association with CRB Capital Markets, a company facing liquidation proceedings for alleged irregularities.

"SEBI has received a copy of representation which they (Daewoo Securities) have sent to the RBI claiming that they are not CRB group company as CRB holds 24 percent shares and two foreign companies hold balance 76 percent shares," SEBI said in a statement.
"After getting decision from RBI, SEBI would inform the stock exchanges," it added.
Daewoo Securities is the Indian affiliate of the South Korean conglomerate.
